title: Economic repairs: per-axis bond, claim delay under open probe exposure, honest L3, verified-work-only tenure (A11, A20)
question: Do the registered economic repairs close the repeatable-cheating business: bond covers the compute saved at any conviction time, wash-ring volume buys no tenure, claim delay tracks exposure, L3 burns only vested-unclaimed?

registered_notes.bond: R-A11a: sized to saving_per_unit x exposure window; forfeitable on conviction; economic, no identity
registered_notes.claim_delay: R-A11b: ceil(open_exposure_units / units_per_epoch) epochs; vested credits stay reachable while detection is pending
registered_notes.l3: R-A11c: L3 = delist + burn vested-but-unclaimed; reachable because claims were frozen
registered_notes.tenure: R-A20: tenure credit accrues only from sampled_challenge and probe_reference records; self-generated volume accrues zero
registered_notes.campaign_recorded: expected forfeit vs expected saved is recorded, not gated: P(convict)=1-beta<1, so the expectation alone understates the bond; the registered reading is deterministic coverage at every conviction time

interpretation_registered_before_running.c1_fails: at some conviction time up to the horizon the forfeit + burn falls below the compute saved - the bond does not cover the arbitrage; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c2_fails: wash-ring volume buys tenure or verified work buys none - the self-payment repair is cosmetic; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c3_fails: claim delay decreases as exposure grows - the reachability of L3 is not established; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c4_fails: L3 burns more than vested or burns a fully-claimed account - the ladder is still not honestly described; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.all_hold: M313 PASS: the economic repairs close A11 and A20 at the registered cells
